# Importzo — Shopify Store Migration App

> Importzo is a free Shopify app that transfers products, themes, pages, blogs, navigation menus, metafields, collections, media, inventory, and customer data between Shopify stores — directly, without CSV files.

## What Importzo Does

Importzo is a store-to-store migration tool for Shopify merchants. It connects two Shopify stores via a one-time session code and copies all store data using the Shopify Admin API. No spreadsheets, no manual downloads, no developer needed.

## Core Features

- **Products & Variants**: All SKUs, prices, compare-at prices, images, tags, options, and product types
- **Themes & Assets**: Complete Liquid themes including templates, assets, and JSON configuration
- **Pages & Blogs**: All online store pages and blog articles with SEO metadata and images
- **Navigation Menus**: Header, footer, and custom menus with nested items
- **Metafields**: Custom data and metafield definitions for all resource types
- **Collections**: Smart and manual collections with rules, sort orders, and assignments
- **Media & Files**: All images, videos, and documents in the Shopify Files library
- **Customers**: Names, emails, phone numbers, and addresses
- **Inventory**: Stock quantities synced by location

## How It Works

1. Install Importzo on both the source and destination Shopify stores (free, from the Shopify App Store)
2. On the source store, generate a one-time session code from the Transfer Store feature
3. On the destination store, enter the session code to pair the stores
4. Select which modules to transfer and click Start — Importzo runs the transfer in the background

## Key Differentiators vs CSV-Based Tools (Matrixify, etc.)

- No CSV files required at any step
- Transfers themes and navigation menus (impossible with CSV tools)
- Direct API-to-API connection — no data reformatting or loss
- Free plan available — no credit card required
- 2-minute setup vs hours of CSV column mapping
- Runs in the background — close the browser during transfer

## Technical Details

- Built on Remix (React Router 7) with Shopify App Bridge 4.x
- Uses Shopify Admin GraphQL API (API version October 2025)
- Embedded Shopify app — runs inside the Shopify Admin
- Session authentication via App Bridge session tokens
- Background job processing for large stores (50,000+ products supported)
- AES-256-CBC encryption for source store credentials stored in database
- GDPR-compliant: customers/data_request, customers/redact, and shop/redact webhooks implemented

## Pricing

All plans are billed through Shopify. Both paid plans include a 7-day free
trial and can be paid monthly or yearly; yearly saves 20%.

- **Free** — $0/month. 1 store, 250 records per month. No credit card required.
- **Pro** — $15/month or $144/year. Unlimited records, scheduled recurring
  sync, and built-in AI SEO cleanup.
- **Agency** — $10/month or $96/year per store. Everything in Pro at a
  discount; unlocks automatically once the same merchant is running Importzo
  on 3 or more stores.

## Common Use Cases

- Cloning a Shopify store for a new market or region
- Migrating from a development store to a production store
- Backing up a store by transferring all data to a second store
- Duplicating a store for a wholesale or B2B variant
- Moving from one Shopify plan to another (new store required)
- White-labeling — setting up identical stores for multiple clients

## Supported Shopify Scopes

read_products, write_products, read_orders, read_inventory, write_inventory, read_themes, write_themes, read_files, write_files, read_content, write_content, read_online_store_pages, read_legal_policies, read_online_store_navigation, write_online_store_navigation, read_customers

## FAQ Summary

**Q: Does Importzo transfer themes?**
A: Yes. Complete Liquid themes with all assets and configuration.

**Q: Does it require CSV files?**
A: No. It works entirely via the Shopify Admin API.

**Q: Is there a free plan?**
A: Yes. Free plan available with no credit card required.

**Q: How long does migration take?**
A: 2-minute setup. Transfer time: minutes for small stores, hours for 50k+ product stores.

**Q: Can it transfer metafields?**
A: Yes. Metafields and metafield definitions for all resource types.

**Q: What's different from Matrixify?**
A: No CSV, themes supported, navigation menus supported, free plan, 2-minute setup.

**Q: How do I copy products between Shopify stores?**
A: Install Importzo on both stores → generate session code on source → enter code on destination → select Products → Start.

**Q: Does it transfer blog posts and pages?**
A: Yes. All blog channels, articles, and pages with full content and SEO metadata.
